Happy Birthday
Name Birthday Person
27   November  2004

Happy birthday, my favorite person! 
 I honestly don’t even know where to start because there’s just so much I could say about you. It’s crazy to think how much we’ve grown together — all the random nights that turned into core memories, the deep talks, the ugly laughing fits, and the times we just sat in silence but still understood each other perfectly.
You’ve been there through so many of my chapters, and I can’t imagine my story without you in it. You’re not just my best friend; you’re truly family to me. You bring so much light into people’s lives — you have this rare mix of softness and strength that’s just beautiful to see.

Every year you grow into a better version of yourself, even when you don’t realize it. You’ve handled things with so much grace, even the hard moments that no one else saw. I hope you take a second today to be proud of yourself — because I really am.

You deserve everything good this world has to offer. The love, the success, the peace, the adventures — all of it. I just know that amazing things are waiting for you, and I can’t wait to see where life takes you next.

Thank you for being you. For being real, for being funny, for always hyping me up, and for making every ordinary moment feel special. I love how we can talk for hours or say nothing at all and still have the best time.

Here’s to another year of memories — more trips, spontaneous plans, matching outfits, and late-night talks about life and love. I’m so proud of you, and I love you endlessly.

Happy Birthday, beautiful. You truly deserve the world. 
Love you always,
Birthday letter for the reader

Name is curious, adventurous, and full of life — the kind of person who sees every day as a chance to explore, laugh, and make memories. She loves discovering new places, meeting fascinating people, and finding inspiration in the little things around her — whether it’s through fashion, art, music, or just wandering around the city and noticing something beautiful she hadn’t seen before.

She’s independent and confident, but also incredibly caring and thoughtful. Friends know her as someone who lights up every room she enters, who listens without judgment, and who somehow makes even the simplest moments feel special. Whether it’s a spontaneous trip with friends, a late-night deep conversation, or a silly adventure that makes everyone laugh until their stomach hurts, Leanna is always in the middle of the fun.

text_fields.source_text:
The Notebook
with Ryan Gosling & Rachel Mcadams

The Notebook is a romantic drama based on Nicholas Sparks’ novel. It tells the story of Noah Calhoun and Allie Hamilton, two young lovers from very different social backgrounds, and follows their journey through love, separation, and enduring devotion. They fall in love one summer, but circumstances and family expectations force them apart. Noah writes letters to Allie, but she never receives them, and years later, she becomes engaged to another man. When they reunite, their love is reignited, showing that true connection can survive time and obstacles.

The story alternates between their youthful romance and their lives as an elderly couple, emphasizing the lifelong impact of love and memory. Director Nick Cassavetes wanted the audience to understand that love is not just about passion but also about patience, forgiveness, and commitment. The film shows that love can transcend social differences, misunderstandings, and life’s challenges, and that expressing feelings honestly is essential. Ultimately, the message of the movie is that true love may not be easy or perfect, but it is worth fighting for every day, and life is too short not to cherish it.
Favourite   Artist

Frank Ocean is more than just a singer — he’s a storyteller. Starting his career as a songwriter for stars like Beyoncé and John Legend, he found his own voice with his mixtape Nostalgia, Ultra (2011) and breakthrough album Channel Orange (2012). His most iconic work, Blonde (2016), changed the sound of modern R&B forever.

text_fields.source_text:
Fav 
Hot  spots

1. Eiffel Tower & Trocadéro
 Of course, no trip to Paris is complete without a photo in front of the Eiffel Tower! For the perfect shot, head to the Trocadéro Gardens — the view is straight out of a postcard. Don’t forget to stay until sunset; the tower lights up beautifully at night.

3. Montmartre & Sacré-Cœur
 Montmartre is the artsy heart of Paris. Wander through its winding streets, admire the colorful street art, and don’t miss the view from the steps of Sacré-Cœur. Bonus: grab a crepe from a local stall and enjoy it while people-watching!

4. Palais-Royal & Jardin du Palais-Royal
 For a more peaceful escape, visit the beautiful gardens and the chic columns of Palais-Royal. It’s a perfect spot for photos or a quiet moment away from the busy city streets.

6. Seine River & Bridges
 Take a stroll along the Seine, cross the charming bridges, and if you can, hop on a river cruise at sunset. Paris looks even more magical from the water.

5. Café Culture & Pastries
 Paris isn’t just about sights — it’s about flavors. Stop at a tiny café for a café au lait, or try the best croissants, macarons, and éclairs. My personal favorite is sitting outside a café, watching the city pass by, and feeling like a true Parisian.
Things
she
Loves
Nothing beats a big plate of creamy, cheesy pasta, it’s her ultimate comfort food! Whether it’s a cozy dinner at home or a fancy Italian restaurant, pasta always makes her smile.
Fresh blooms make everything better. She adores colorful bouquets, delicate scents, and the little joy flowers bring to any space. They’re her go-to for a happy, bright mood.
Music is her favorite form of art. It tells stories and translates feelings and thoughts in ways words never can. It inspires her. It might be her favourite thing ever!

New cities, cultures, and adventures are her ultimate thrill. Whether it’s wandering cobblestone streets in Europe or relaxing on a sunny beach, travel fills her life with memories she’ll never forget.

She loves hunting for hidden gems, whether it’s fashion finds, cute accessories, or little treats for herself and friends. Shopping isn’t just a hobby — it’s a way to explore her style and have fun along the way.
